item.title: Entertaining Angels
item.description: Since I began parish life, I’ve boiled 7,000 gallons of water and poured 200,000 cups of tea. I’ve also baked 4,600 medium sized quiches and personally made 2 tons of shortcrust pastry Entertaining Angels by Richard Everett.
